sources: Summ, summ, summ — Bohemian folk melody, text Hoffmann von Fallersleben (1835); public domain
notes: C position (C-G). Note values doubled from the usual 2/4 notation (quarter-quarter-half, four eighths-half) so only halves, quarters and wholes are needed at level 0; the proportions are unchanged. Written out from memory in the simplest form; no network in the build environment, so not compared against an online score. Needs a listen by a person.
